As we scale production, we are looking for Production Operators who take pride in executing critical manufacturing processes with accuracy, discipline and attention to detail.

You will play a key role in ensuring stable, safe and high-quality production.

Product quality

Process stability

Production efficiency

Operate production equipment such as furnaces, coating lines and cutting machines.

jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced Scrum Master for a new development project focused on automotive interior and seat development. The role is responsible for leading and supporting a cross-functional development team, maintaining alignment with project objectives, and driving planning, execution, and delivery in accordance with agile principles.
The Scrum Master will facilitate effective ways of working, coordinate team activities and milestones, and promote collaboration among engineering teams, project management, and other stakeholders. The assignment also includes financial oversight, risk and dependency management, status reporting, and continuous improvement of the team and its development processes.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and support a cross-functional development team throughout project planning, execution, follow-up, and delivery.
Facilitate Scrum practices and other agile ways of working while ensuring alignment with project goals, delivery plans, and milestones.
Coordinate team activities and promote effective collaboration across engineering disciplines and stakeholder groups.
Monitor and report the project's financial position, including investments, material expenditure, and development costs.
Provide regular progress, delivery, and financial status updates to project management.
Identify and manage project risks, dependencies, obstacles, and delivery constraints.
Build stakeholder alignment through structured communication, facilitation, and negotiation.
Drive continuous improvement within the team and across the broader product development process.
Support timely decision-making while maintaining focus on project targets and financial performance.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Agile and Scrum: Practical experience applying agile principles and facilitating Scrum-based development.
Project management: Experience with project planning, execution, delivery coordination, follow-up, and milestone management.
Cross-functional delivery: Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate multidisciplinary development teams.
Financial management: Experience monitoring budgets, investments, material costs, development costs, and overall project financials.
Risk and dependency management: Ability to identify, track, escalate, and resolve risks, dependencies, and delivery obstacles.
Stakeholder management: Experience facilitating alignment and coordinating decisions across multiple functions and organizational levels.

Qualifications & Experience
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline, is required. Candidates must have at least four years of experience as a Project Leader, Project Manager, Scrum Master, or in a comparable leadership role. The role requires experience in agile development environments, cross-functional team coordination, project planning and follow-up, financial reporting, facilitation, and stakeholder management. Professional spoken and written English is required.
Experience in automotive product development, particularly interior systems or seat development, is advantageous. Additional merits include a background in mechanical engineering and product development, experience working in large international organizations, and professional spoken and written Swedish.

Experience in software development, with a focus on frontend or backend development.

Experience with software architecture concepts such as APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, or system integrations.
Experience with development tools or environments such as CI/CD pipelines, container platforms, cloud services, monitoring tools, version control, or deployment automation.

2MNordic is looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer for a long-term client assignment in Malmö. You will build complex web interfaces where performance, reliability, accessibility and privacy are central to the user experience.
You will join a small, autonomous team and take ownership from early design discussions through
development, testing and production. The role suits someone who can turn broad requirements into practical solutions, challenge assumptions and adapt as priorities evolve.
Your responsibilities
• Develop and maintain web applications using React, TypeScript and modern CSS.
• Work closely with designers, product managers and backend engineers to deliver usable, reliable interfaces.
• Build complex single-page applications with effective state management and data-heavy views.
• Improve performance through code splitting, lazy loading and rendering optimisation.
• Integrate REST APIs, handling latency, failures and incomplete data throughout the user experience.
• Make accessibility and automated testing part of everyday delivery.
• Break larger features into manageable increments and contribute to technical decisions, code reviews and documentation.
Practical details
This assignment requires onsite presence in Malmö. You should already be based within commuting distance or be willing to relocate. The assignment is long term, allowing you to build domain knowledge and contribute throughout the product lifecycle.
Your experience
• Typically five or more years of frontend development experience, with applications delivered and
maintained in production.
• Strong JavaScript knowledge, including asynchronous behaviour, the event loop, browser rendering
and memory management.
• Deep practical experience with React, TypeScript and modern CSS.
• Proven ability to diagnose issues across devices, slow networks and large datasets.
• A strong understanding of user experience and interaction design, including how interfaces behave
with real data.
• Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, Docker and GitHub workflows.
• The ability to investigate dependencies beyond their documentation when needed.
• Clear written and verbal communication in English, including explaining technical decisions to different audiences.
• Confidence working independently while coordinating dependencies across teams.
Additional merits
• Familiarity with WebAssembly, WebGPU, canvas rendering or browser security.
• Backend development knowledge, particularly Java.
About 2MNordic
2MNordic is a Swedish IT consultancy founded in 2001. We help companies turn technological
complexity into operational capability through software development, solution architecture, automation, AI and data.
As a consultant with 2MNordic, you contribute your expertise to client assignments while being part of an experienced consultancy with close collaboration and a practical approach to delivery.
Learn more at 2mnordic.com.
Interested in this assignment?
Send us your CV or consultant profile, availability and a short overview of your React and TypeScript experience. Please include your current location and ability to work onsite in Malmö

As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. Job description: 
 Plan and deliver complex international project schedules
 Are you an experienced project planner who enjoys working with large-scale projects from tender phase through execution to completion? Working closely with international teams, clients, and project stakeholders, you will help ensure transparent and reliable project execution. Would you like to contribute to some of the infrastructure projects shaping a more sustainable future?

 Structured planner with collaborative stakeholder approach

You communicate clearly, build positive working relationships, and are comfortable discussing different perspectives to support well-founded project decisions. You take ownership of your work, maintain a methodical approach, and keep focus on quality and accuracy.
  
 You also have:

 • Extensive experience in project planning within large project environments

 • Experience with project reporting and data visualisation tools such as Power BI
 • Professional fluency in English, written and spoken
 • Experience from renewable energy, offshore wind, submarine cable, oil & gas, EPC or large infrastructure projects is considered advantageous

At Tata Technologies, we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering, and delivering the products of tomorrow for the world's leading manufacturers.
We are currently looking for a Embedded Software Engineer to join a highly innovative team developing next-generation Active Chassis and Suspension Systems for future vehicle platforms.
